# the contributor independent audit: anisotropic strip response

Read candidate e306f52a74c4defa
in full. PASS; no mathematical correction. The verifier reruns PASS945
exact tail minima,84 balances,80 actual seven-fiber caps.

The affine strip Jacobian is t, its stated volume and containment
conditions are correct, and all seven fibers are actual by the exposed
base quadrilateral. The conditional weak limit and failure of bounded
isotropic blowup are explicit.

The paired-tail identity is correct for either sign of the center
threshold. Convolution gives a bound1/(2H) uniformly in every projected
slope, including zero. The alternative long-coordinate density bound
controls unbounded slopes. A saturated finite shift gives the matching
upper value one; there is no compactness assumption hiding a lost
unbounded-shift regime.

Near l_0, dividing by u.w is a legitimate positive normalization and
gives the exact projected variable r+sigma s. Its center threshold is
U.v, so the lower profile survives arbitrary normal/thickness ratios.
At the exact canonical normal the lower profile is attained. Near
l_1 and l_2 the uniform long-coordinate density bound gives response a
for every bounded candidate displacement sequence. The own normal
excess is retained as nonnegative; no rate of normal convergence is
assumed in the all-direction lower argument.

Checked the unique envelope optimization, including the strict crossing
inside(c,0), equality of the two other scores, and the explicit vector.
O(t) localization plus subsequence upper bounds gives every maximizing
displacement; it does not assume finite-t uniqueness. The exact owned-
fiber reduction and strict global coefficient identify the actual base.

For L=1/6,H=1, the values a=2/3, v_0=-1/5, v_1=v_2=1/10,
L_*=3/5, global coefficient19/15 and normalized derivative47/90 all
check. The canonical second-order terms1/50 and1/200 have the correct
normalization. This is a proved global response in a restricted source,
not an unrestricted OC center theorem.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
